newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea sells dollars at 884.80 - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea sells dollars at 884.80 - dealers.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea (BOK) stepped into late morning interbank trading on Thursday to sell dollars as the won fell to the 884.80 level, dealers said.
The central bank has refused to confirm or deny that it intervenes in the market.
The won rose to 883.50 just after the intervention.
Dealers said the dollar's bullish trend would be difficult to stem due to the nation's widening trade deficit and the U.S. unit's strong trend against the Japanese yen on world markets.
